title: Product inner product on the sign cube
statement: For every natural number $n$ and functions $f,g:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, their product inner product under independent uniform signs equals their uniform inner product, that is, the average of $f(x)g(x)$ over all $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$.
